note: 插件/扩展的界面文案汉化词典（斜杠命令补全说明、提示词模板说明）；用法同 zh-dict.json。roots 里写相对路径时，相对于 <agent>/npm/node_modules 解析；用环境变量 PI_PLUGIN_NM_DIR 可换成别的目录（也可以直接写绝对路径）。

entries.anchor: description: "Administer subagents: inspect metadata and update models, thinking, or prompts"
entries.zh: description: "管理子代理：查看元数据，并调整模型、思考等级或提示词"

entries.anchor: description: "Run one subagent through workflowScript: /run agent[output=file] [task] [--bg] [--fork]"
entries.zh: description: "用 workflowScript 运行单个子代理：/run agent[output=file] [task] [--bg] [--fork]"

entries.anchor: description: "Show parent and subagent child usage cost for this session"
entries.zh: description: "显示本会话中主会话与子代理的用量成本"

entries.anchor: description: "Show subagent diagnostics"
entries.zh: description: "显示子代理诊断信息"

entries.anchor: description: "Host integration bridge: answer an async child inspection request with a correlated widget payload (no model turn)"
entries.zh: description: "宿主集成桥：用一个关联的 widget 载荷应答异步子任务检查请求（不消耗模型回合）"

entries.anchor: description: "Show a packaged subagents guide topic"
entries.zh: description: "显示内置的子代理指南主题"

entries.anchor: description: "Generate a bounded project-local refinement overlay for one subagent"
entries.zh: description: "为单个子代理生成项目本地、有边界的细化覆盖层"

entries.anchor: description: "Open the live subagent fleet inspector"
entries.zh: description: "打开实时子代理集群查看器"

entries.anchor: description: "Detach the active foreground single-subagent run without terminating it"
entries.zh: description: "把当前前台运行的单子代理任务转为后台，但不终止它"

entries.anchor: description: "Stop a current-session async subagent run, or one child of it with /subagents-stop <run-id> <child-id>"
entries.zh: description: "停止本会话中的异步子代理运行；加 <run-id> <child-id> 可只停止其中一个子任务"

entries.anchor: description: "Steer a live async subagent run with a message, or one child of it with --child <child-id>"
entries.zh: description: "向运行中的异步子代理发送引导消息；用 --child <child-id> 可只作用于某个子任务"

entries.anchor: description: "Show model mappings for discovered subagents"
entries.zh: description: "显示已发现子代理的模型映射"

entries.anchor: description: "List saved subagent profiles"
entries.zh: description: "列出已保存的子代理配置档案"

entries.anchor: description: "Load a subagent profile into ~/.pi/agent/settings.json"
entries.zh: description: "把某个子代理配置档案载入 ~/.pi/agent/settings.json"

entries.anchor: description: "Refresh the cached model catalog for one provider"
entries.zh: description: "刷新指定 provider 的模型目录缓存"

entries.anchor: description: "Generate <provider>.quota and <provider>.quality subagent profiles"
entries.zh: description: "生成 <provider>.quota 与 <provider>.quality 两套子代理配置档案"

entries.anchor: description: "Check whether a saved profile still points to usable models"
entries.zh: description: "检查已保存的配置档案是否仍指向可用模型"

entries.anchor: description: "Run a prompt template through native pi-subagents: /prompt-workflow <name> [args]"
entries.zh: description: "用原生 pi-subagents 运行提示词模板：/prompt-workflow <name> [args]"

entries.anchor: description: "Internal pane-native request dispatch"
entries.zh: description: "内部：pane 原生请求分发"

entries.anchor: description: "Show or toggle the default-off subagent watchdog"
entries.zh: description: "查看或切换默认关闭的子代理看门狗"

entries.anchor: description: Run a bounded supervisor-mediated council of advisors and write a decision memo
entries.zh: description: 运行一个有边界的、由主管主持的顾问团，并输出决策备忘

entries.anchor: description: Use subagents to gather context, then ask clarifying questions
entries.zh: description: 先用子代理收集上下文，再提出澄清问题

entries.anchor: description: Parallel cleanup review
entries.zh: description: 并行清理评审

entries.anchor: description: Parallel subagents research
entries.zh: description: 并行子代理调研

entries.anchor: description: Parallel subagents review
entries.zh: description: 并行子代理评审

entries.anchor: description: Review/fix loop until clean
entries.zh: description: 评审/修复循环，直到干净

entries.anchor: description: "Draft a regular goal with clarification, task planning, and confirmation."
entries.zh: description: "起草普通 goal：先澄清需求，再规划任务并确认。"

entries.anchor: description: "Draft a Sisyphus goal with clarification, task planning, and confirmation."
entries.zh: description: "起草 Sisyphus goal：先澄清需求，再规划任务并确认。"

entries.anchor: description: "Cancel the in-progress guided draft without creating or modifying a goal."
entries.zh: description: "取消进行中的引导式起草，不创建也不修改 goal。"

entries.anchor: description: "Create and start a regular goal immediately, without drafting."
entries.zh: description: "跳过起草，立即创建并启动普通 goal。"

entries.anchor: description: "Create and start a Sisyphus goal immediately, without drafting."
entries.zh: description: "跳过起草，立即创建并启动 Sisyphus goal。"

entries.anchor: description: "List all open goals and the current focus."
entries.zh: description: "列出所有未完成的 goal 以及当前焦点。"

entries.anchor: description: "Show the unified goal dashboard (read-only). Append \"verbose\" for full detail or \"health\" for storage/runtime checks."
entries.zh: description: "显示统一的 goal 仪表盘（只读）。附加 \"verbose\" 看完整细节，附加 \"health\" 做存储/运行时检查。"

entries.anchor: description: "Re-read goal storage caches (pool, ledger, settings) from disk and report what changed. Picks up external edits to .pi files — no file watchers needed."
entries.zh: description: "从磁盘重新读取 goal 存储缓存（池、账本、设置）并报告变化。可感知对 .pi 文件的外部修改 —— 无需文件监视器。"

entries.anchor: description: "Read-only storage/recovery report (malformed goal files, malformed ledger lines, stale locks, orphaned snapshot data). Append \"repair\" to remove stale locks and refresh the pool snapshot after confirmation (with backup)."
entries.zh: description: "只读的存储/恢复报告（损坏的 goal 文件、损坏的账本行、过期锁、孤立快照数据）。附加 \"repair\" 可在确认后清除过期锁并刷新池快照（会先备份）。"

entries.anchor: description: "Choose which open goal this session focuses on."
entries.zh: description: "选择本会话聚焦哪个未完成的 goal。"

entries.anchor: description: "Stop focusing the current goal (session only; goal stays open)."
entries.zh: description: "取消聚焦当前 goal（仅本会话；goal 仍保持打开）。"

entries.anchor: description: "Open pi-goal settings (auditor provider/model/thinking level)."
entries.zh: description: "打开 pi-goal 设置（审计用 provider/模型/思考等级）。"

entries.anchor: description: "Refine the current goal's objective with the user."
entries.zh: description: "与用户一起细化当前 goal 的目标。"

entries.anchor: description: "Archive the current goal after confirmation (user-owned abandonment)."
entries.zh: description: "确认后归档当前 goal（由用户主动放弃）。"

entries.anchor: description: "Pause the currently running goal. Esc also pauses while running."
entries.zh: description: "暂停正在运行的 goal。运行中按 Esc 也会暂停。"

entries.anchor: description: "Continue now and renew the configured autonomous-run allowance."
entries.zh: description: "立即继续，并重置已配置的自主运行额度。"

entries.anchor: description: "Open web search curator"
entries.zh: description: "打开联网搜索管理器"

entries.anchor: description: "Toggle or configure the search curator workflow"
entries.zh: description: "切换或配置搜索管理器工作流"

entries.anchor: description: "Show the active Google account for Gemini Web"
entries.zh: description: "显示 Gemini Web 当前使用的 Google 账号"

entries.anchor: description: "Browse stored web search results"
entries.zh: description: "浏览已保存的联网搜索结果"

entries.anchor: description: "Toggle plannotator planning mode"
entries.zh: description: "切换 plannotator 规划模式"

entries.anchor: description: "Open interactive code review for current changes or a PR URL; pass --git or --gitbutler to force that provider, --base <ref> / --diff-type <type> to pin the session's opening diff"
entries.zh: description: "对当前改动或 PR URL 打开交互式代码评审；用 --git 或 --gitbutler 指定 provider，用 --base <ref> / --diff-type <type> 固定本次会话打开的 diff"

entries.anchor: description: "Open markdown file or folder in annotation UI"
entries.zh: description: "在标注界面中打开 markdown 文件或文件夹"

entries.anchor: description: "Annotate the last assistant message"
entries.zh: description: "标注最后一条助手消息"

entries.anchor: "Configure pi-permission-system logging and yolo-mode behavior"
entries.zh: "配置 pi-permission-system 的日志与 yolo 模式行为"

entries.anchor: description: "Toggle pi-lens on/off for the current session. Usage: /lens-toggle"
entries.zh: description: "切换本会话的 pi-lens 开关。用法：/lens-toggle"

entries.anchor: description: "Toggle automatic context injection on/off for the current session (tools/LSP/read-guard/formatting stay active). Usage: /lens-context-toggle"
entries.zh: description: "切换本会话的自动上下文注入（工具/LSP/读取守卫/格式化保持启用）。用法：/lens-context-toggle"

entries.anchor: description: "Show or hide the pi-lens diagnostics widget below the editor. Usage: /lens-widget-toggle"
entries.zh: description: "显示或隐藏编辑器下方的 pi-lens 诊断小组件。用法：/lens-widget-toggle"

entries.anchor: description: "Show Technical Debt Index (TDI) and project health trend. Usage: /lens-tdi"
entries.zh: description: "显示技术债指数（TDI）与项目健康度趋势。用法：/lens-tdi"

entries.anchor: description: "Render the review graph as a self-contained interactive HTML project map (pan/zoom/hover/click) and write it to disk. Usage: /lens-map"
entries.zh: description: "把审查图谱渲染成自包含的交互式 HTML 项目地图（可平移/缩放/悬停/点击）并写入磁盘。用法：/lens-map"

entries.anchor: description: "Show pi-lens runtime health: pipeline crashes, slow runners, and last dispatch latency. Usage: /lens-health"
entries.zh: description: "显示 pi-lens 运行时健康状况：流水线崩溃、慢速 runner、最近一次分发的延迟。用法：/lens-health"

entries.anchor: description: "Show the slowest latency-log phases by p50 and p99 for the current process session and machine-wide active log window. Usage: /lens-perf"
entries.zh: description: "按 p50/p99 列出当前进程会话与整机日志窗口中最慢的延迟阶段。用法：/lens-perf"

entries.anchor: description: "Show pi-lens tool installation status: globally installed, auto-installed, or npx fallback. Usage: /lens-tools"
entries.zh: description: "显示 pi-lens 工具安装状态：全局安装、自动安装，还是 npx 回退。用法：/lens-tools"

entries.anchor: description: "Allow one edit to a file without a prior read. Usage: /lens-allow-edit <path>"
entries.zh: description: "允许对某个文件在未先读取的情况下执行一次编辑。用法：/lens-allow-edit <path>"

entries.anchor: description: 'Mem0 memory commands. Subcommands: status, search <query>, profile, add <text>, dedup [--apply], delete <id>.'
entries.zh: description: 'Mem0 记忆命令。子命令：status、search <query>、profile、add <text>、dedup [--apply]、delete <id>。'

entries.anchor: description: "Review recently changed code for clarity, consistency, and maintainability improvements"
entries.zh: description: "审查近期改动的代码，给出可读性、一致性与可维护性方面的改进建议"

entries.anchor: description: "Show all todos on the current branch, grouped by status"
entries.zh: description: "列出当前分支上的所有 todo，按状态分组"
